title: Insurer Appeals in Progress — Renewal Notice Allowance
content:
**Clause.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), days are added to the response days of a renewal's missing-information notice while an insurer appeal is in progress, the claim under appeal being the claim named by the most recent appeal filed on any of the patient's Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claims (on a same-day tie, the appeal listed first in the claim activity) while that claim is in appealed status.

| Most recent appeal | Its claim in appealed status | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| member appeal filed under the patient's authorization | yes | 10 |
| any other type | yes | 5 |
| any type | no | none |
| no appeal | — | none |
